alex: Quick flag: staging p99 jumped ~220ms after today's model-onboard. Observed token-length distribution skew (more long tails). Suspect tokenizer change + prefetch window interplay. Anyone oncall?

mira: Oncall, looking. Where are you seeing spikes? endpoints/variant X or all models?

alex: Only staging for the new checkpoint (redwood/gamma-3b-v2). Traffic routed by model tag. Mostly text-gen routes /v1/complete. p50 unchanged, p95 up 30ms, p99 up 220ms. Kernel selection logs show more fallback to 'sparse-attn' path.

jamal: Dropping profiler snippet, looks like KV cache miss rate jumped and batch sizes dropped. Repro steps and logs below.
```bash
# reproduce
ab -n 500 -c 4 -p long_prompt.json http://staging/api/v1/complete
# sample log
2026-03-18T09:14:22Z model=gamma-3b-v2 kernel=sparse-attn selected=true batch_size=2 kv_hit=false prefetch_ms=12
2026-03-18T09:14:22Z batch_delay_ms=6
```
prefetch_window_ms was 12 -> maybe too small for longer tokens

cheng: Noting: recent PR #3421 changed tokenizer.normalize_newlines=true and bumped continuous-batching.batch_delay_ms default 6->3 to reduce latency for short prompts. That reduces batching horizon -> more small batches -> higher per-token overhead + less time to prefetch KV, so more KV misses. @jamal can you bisect between commit abc123..def456? :eyes:

ops-bot: ci-bot: perf/regression check failed on staging-run-2026-03-18-09:10 (p99 +215ms). See https://ci.internal/reports/perm/reg/2298475 for artifacts

sasha: Quick mitigation: 1) revert batch_delay_ms change to 6 on staging config (hotfix), 2) pin tokenizer mapping to previous normalizer (normalize_newlines=false) for gamma-3b-v2, or 3) route small percentage to gamma-3b-v1 fallback. I'd prefer 1+3 immediate.

alex: Agree. Jamal + Cheng, can you try a config revert hotfix on staging and run the perf job? If that restores p99, we'll file a rollback PR for the release. Also create an eval set for long-tail tokens.

jamal: Bisect done: culprit is PR #3421 (commit def456) which contained both the normalize_newlines change and batch_delay_ms default. Quick diff:
```diff
- continuous-batching:
-   batch_delay_ms: 6
+ continuous-batching:
+   batch_delay_ms: 3
...
- tokenizer:
-   normalize_newlines: false
+ tokenizer:
+   normalize_newlines: true
```
I applied just revert of batch_delay_ms -> staging p99 back to baseline. With batch_delay_ms=6, kv_hit=true more often, batch_size increased from 2->5.

cheng: :tada: Nice. Jamal can you open revert PR urgent? We'll follow-up to see if normalizer change requires a mapping migration instead of a rollback.

mira: I'll open the rollout-blocker ticket P0 with logs, perf artifacts, and recommended hotfix (revert batch_delay_ms). Also add a regression test to CI that checks token length histogram and KV hit ratio for model-onboards. Assigning to jamal + cheng. :white_check_mark:

alex: Thanks everyone. Keep me posted. After revert, schedule proper onboarding: tokenizer mapping migration + adjust prefetch_window_ms to 20ms for long-tail models. Action items in ticket.
